## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector positivity (8/11) but multiple major divergences among megacaps (AAPL, META, TSLA showing 1W/1M mismatches) and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology leading: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND — Tech: 18/24 positive (Sector Strength). Industrials strong: BA (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +5.07%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) RECOVERY — Industrials: 12/15 positive (Sector Strength). Consumer Discretionary firm: HD (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +4.99%) ABOVE TREND, BKNG (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +22.16%) ABOVE TREND — Consumer Disc.: 9/14 positive (Internal Rotation).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy lagging: CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION, XOM (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +11.33%) CORRECTION — Energy: 2/10 positive (Sector Weakness). Utilities weak: VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND — Utilities: 3/10 positive (Sector Weakness). Real Estate soft (Internal Rotation) with muted 1W performance.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5 (SP100 focus): QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, INTC (1W: +12.69% | 1M: -9.68%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +14.74%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology); Style: Growth/Momentum tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5 (SP100 focus): VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND, MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Utilities and select Energy names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Big 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, INTC (1W: +12.69% | 1M: -9.68%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +14.74%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among megacaps (AAPL, META, TSLA 1W/1M mismatches) — watch for trend breaks rather than broad commitment.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech shows sector strength but narrow leadership: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY — Tech: 18/24 positive (Sector Strength). Risk: concentrated gains mean momentum names could see fast reversals if breadth narrows.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are constructive but mixed: JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +4.11%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +7.60%) CORRECTION — Financials: 11/20 positive (Internal Rotation). Style: Value/Cyclical elements present but no unanimous breadth confirmation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare steady with select strength: PFE (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +0.05%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY — Healthcare: 9/17 positive (Internal Rotation). Note bullish LLY news aligns with short-term price lift but 1M still negative.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to Financials and Industrials (JPM ABOVE TREND, BA ABOVE TREND, CAT RECOVERY) and monitor tech momentum names closely; reduce exposure to concentrated leadership until breadth broadens. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but be selective given narrow tech leadership and megacap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION, EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION, CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (Tech: 18/24 positive) and Industrials (Industrials: 12/15 positive) for continuation. BEARISH: Energy (Energy: 2/10 positive) and Utilities (Utilities: 3/10 positive) for downside risk and earnings/operational headlines.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) — failure to hold recent breakout would signal short-term mean reversion; AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) — watch if 1W gains fade below recent support for renewed downside; JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) — sustained trade above 1M trend would confirm Financials leadership; CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) — reclaim of the 1W range needed to stabilize energy exposure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LLY (+80): Eli Lilly (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY — blowout growth headline supports upside but 1M remains negative (partial confirmation). CAT (+80): Caterpillar (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) RECOVERY — strong beat/guidance but 1M weakness suggests a tactical bounce. VST (+60): Vistra (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND — bullish press but price is diverging (distribution risk).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
META (-45): Meta (1W: +6.36% | 1M: -6.24%) RECOVERY — negative headlines while price is up this week indicates headline-driven noise and potential distribution. CAT (-45): Caterpillar also appears in negative headlines (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) RECOVERY — mixed sentiment on CAT; monitor for guidance/tariff follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given narrow Tech leadership. MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: leadership is concentrated in Tech and multiple megacaps show 1W/1M divergence (watch for trend breaks and sentiment-driven reversals).
